messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-05-22 the Dune team noticed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-2]
- As of 2025-12-29, the auth gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-29]
- On 2026-01-30 the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- The authentication gateway is owned by Cinder as of 2025-09-16, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- On 2025-09-03 the Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2]
- As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka holds the Cinder pager, taking over from Diego, who is leaving the team. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-24, Diego holds the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-10-24 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-24]
- On 2025-09-16 Oskar wrote the authentication gateway handover doc for Diego. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-18]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Per Ember team policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-07-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-07-29]
- The billing API was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to the Ember team on 2026-01-12. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it. [valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]

    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2026-01-12, having moved from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
- On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- The indexer was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder, until ownership transferred to the Boreal team on 2026-04-01. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]

- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus. [valid 2025-08-15 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2]
